test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the most gender equal country, according to Global Gender Gap Report 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iceland.**__

__
 
• According to Global Gender Gap Report 2021, **Iceland** is the most gender-equal country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iceland**, for the **12th** time, has topped the index. 
 
• **The World Economic Forum (WEF)** has released the Global Gender Gap Report 2021. 
 
• **India** has ranked** 140 **among 156 countries in Global Gender Gap Index 2021, which is 28 spots lower than its 2020 ranking.
 
• **Afghanistan** is the worst performing country which is ranked at **156**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Global Gender Gap Index **seeks to measure one important aspect of gender equality: the relative gaps between women and men, across a large set of countries and across four key areas: health, education, economics and politics.
 
• World Economic Forum's headquarter is in **Cologny, Switzerland. **
 
• The WEF is chaired by founder and executive chairman Professor **Klaus Schwab. **
 
• Iceland capital and currency: **Reykjavík****, ****Icelandic krona**
